gloss: in an instant; in a flash; instantly

definitions.gloss: in an instant; in a flash; instantly
definitions.explanation: Describes something happening in an extremely short moment. Formed from {一瞬|いっしゅん} (a moment) plus the particle で marking the span of time over which something occurs.

examples.japanese: {一瞬|いっしゅん}で⟦{消|き}えた→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一瞬|いっしゅん}で⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The fire spread in a flash.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一瞬|いっしゅん}で⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: With one word from him, the mood of the room changed in an instant.

notes:
Adverbial phrase built from the noun ⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧ (a moment, a split second) plus ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}で{終|お}わる: to be over in an instant
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}で⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧: to disappear instantly
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}で⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧: to decide in a split second

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦あっという{間|ま}に→あっという間に：25467_attoiumani⟧: in the blink of an eye — emphasizes that time passed faster than expected
- ⟦{瞬時|しゅんじ}→瞬時：13662_shunji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: instantaneously — more formal and technical
